We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: person set fire while sweeping ancestor's grave, causing forest fire, burning forest area 8.4 hectares. Likely crime: "非法开火导致森林火灾" which is under "非法毁灭森林资源罪" (illegal destruction of forest resources) or "放火罪" (arson). In Chinese law, causing forest fire by negligence may be "过失毁灭森林资源罪" (negligent destruction of forest resources) under Article 338 of Criminal Law: "违反森林防火管理规定，造成森林、草原、湿地等自然资源损失的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" That's "非法毁灭森林资源罪" (illegal destruction of forest resources). Also could be "放火罪" (arson) under Article 114: "放火罪" includes intentionally setting fire. Here it's accidental due to negligence, so not intentional arson. So the appropriate charge is "非法毁灭森林资源罪" (illegal destruction of forest resources). In examples, they used "盗伐林木" for illegal logging. For forest fire, they might use "非法毁灭森林资源罪".
